about: Worked out with WoWSims Forever's own Stat Weights tool (wowsims.com/forever/warlock/dps, game 1.60.1.70938, site built 2026-11-17 from commit ad6b13a), since its warlock sim ships no weights. Its Destro preset (talents 18/0/33, rotation, buffs) on that build's own gear set (ui/specs/warlock/dps/gear_sets/destro.gear.json, as the preset loads it), 12,500 iterations, reference stat Spell Damage. DPS EP as the tool shows it; '1%' rows are per 1%. Run in the app's browser on 17 Nov 2026 (US Central). Before it (14 Nov, on preraid.gear.json): Stamina 0.0, Intellect 0.29, Spell Damage 1.0, Fire Spell Damage 0.64, Shadow Spell Damage 0.36, Spell Piercing 1.23, Spirit 0.13, 1% Hit 10.93, 1% Crit 8.84, 1% Haste 7.21, MP5 0.28.
